pull.title: KAFKA-21213: Reject Streams assignor names with surrounding whitespace.
pull.body:
Fixes KAFKA-21213

Streams custom assignor names are registered unchanged, but `streams.assignor.name` trims configuration values. An assignor named `" regional "` can therefore work as the default while being impossible to select explicitly through group configuration.

Reject surrounding whitespace during registration and document the name constraint. Add loader tests for leading spaces, trailing spaces, tabs, and newlines.
